curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8283-1-1.pdf (the telehandler, functions on page 3; book 2, omr/instructions/8283-1-2.pdf, builds the alternate front end loader)

functions.does: The yellow knob on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its column runs down through the cab to an 8-tooth gear driving a 24-tooth gear, which swings the steering arms.
functions.source: book 1: page 3 (knob and top view of the front wheels steering); steps 35-36 (column and knob)
functions.note: Read from the model file: that the 8-tooth gear at the column's foot (p50) drives the 24-tooth gear (p54) that works the steering, and which parts form the steering linkage to the front wheels' arms.

functions.does: The left of the two knobs at the back (a 12-tooth double bevel gear) raises and lowers the boom: it turns a worm, which turns a 24-tooth gear on the boom's pivot axle.
functions.source: book 1: page 3 (knobs at the back, icon of the boom lifting); steps 8-9 (worm and knob), 11 (24-tooth gear), 23 (boom on its pivot, inset of the worm and gear)
functions.note: Which knob does which is read from the gears in the model file (the left knob's worm meets the 24-tooth gear on the boom's pivot axle); page 3 doesn't make it plain. The worm holds the boom wherever it's left.

functions.does: The right of the two knobs at the back (a 12-tooth double bevel gear) extends and retracts the boom: it turns a second worm, which turns an 8-tooth gear at the boom's foot, and that slides the inner boom with the bucket out of the outer one.
functions.source: book 1: page 3 (icon of the boom extending); steps 22-24 (inner and outer boom); inferred: the linkage between the 8-tooth gear and the inner boom
functions.note: How the 8-tooth gear drives the inner boom isn't clear from the book or the model file (a crank on the cross axle p117 and the thin beams inside the boom are a guess). The worm holds the boom at whatever length it's left.

functions.does: Turning the axle end at the boom's head tilts the bucket: a worm on that axle turns an 8-tooth gear on the bucket's pivot axle.
functions.source: book 1: page 3 (inset: the axle end turned, the bucket tilting); steps 5-11 on pages 35-38 (boom head with worm and 8-tooth gear), 39 (bucket)
functions.note: The worm holds the bucket wherever it's left.

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely; nothing drives them.
The steering wheel in the cab is for show: it sits on a half pin and turns, but isn't linked to the front wheels.
functions.source: inferred: from the model file (p231 on the half pin p229); the book shows the yellow roof knob doing the steering
